description: [NEEDS ADMISSION: enroll, then atlas.bind_actor] Locate an Atlas-MCP record. FIND is not READ PRIVATE CONTENT is not MODIFY is not DECIDE is not EXECUTE. Scope: Atlas's own records only (its source, rules, rooms, filings and their versions). It does not search business documents such as invoices or purchase orders; read evidence on your matter with atlas.get_matter.

actor_token.description: Your credential from atlas.enroll or atlas.authenticate. Send it on every call after enrolling.

question.description: What you want to find or ask, in plain words.
